Know what you’re choosing.

A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Ready when you are.

Explore plans and pricing ↗
What is HireHub?+

HireHub is a UK-first platform connecting employers and candidates through structured profiles, job posts and optional AI-assisted matching.

What happens when I click register?+

You’ll go to the HireHub portal to create an employer or candidate account. This website introduces the platform; your profile and hiring activity are managed in your account.

Is it free to register as a candidate?+

Yes. Creating a candidate account is free. CV upload and the guided AI CV builder with one download are listed as free. Optional identity verification is a one-time £10 payment.

Do I have to use AI matching?+

No. AI-assisted matching is optional. Employers can also browse profiles using filters. People make the hiring decisions.

Does HireHub guarantee a job or a hire?+

No. Matches support discovery, but employers make hiring decisions and opportunities depend on the roles and candidates available.
